description: This file defines classes, enums, and an interface related to lease management in the Orleans framework, including lease acquisition, renewal, and release operations.

classes.name: AcquiredLease
classes.description: Represents an acquired lease with resource key, duration, token, and start time.

classes.name: AcquireLeaseResult
classes.description: Encapsulates the result of an acquire or renew lease operation, including the lease, status code, and failure exception.

classes.name: ResponseCode
classes.description: Enumeration of possible response statuses for lease operations.

classes.name: LeaseRequest
classes.description: Represents a request to acquire a lease with specified resource key and duration.

classes.name: ILeaseProvider
classes.description: Interface defining methods for batch acquiring, renewing, and releasing leases.

methods.name: AcquiredLease (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes an AcquiredLease with resource key, duration, token, and start time.

methods.name: AcquiredLease (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes an AcquiredLease with only resource key.

methods.name: AcquireLeaseResult (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes an AcquireLeaseResult with lease, status code, and exception.

methods.name: LeaseRequest (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a LeaseRequest with resource key and duration.
